user.title: Connect to UniFi OS console
user.description: Use a local UniFi OS account without MFA that may manage UniFi Access. The connection stays in your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the console (UDM, UNVR, UCG, …).
data_description.username: Local account (not a UI.com cloud account).
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the self-signed certificate of the console.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The console {host} rejected the stored credentials.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the console (UDM, UNVR, UCG, …).
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the self-signed certificate of the console.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password (or the account requires MFA).
error.no_access: Logged in, but the UniFi Access API is not reachable. Is Access installed and does the account have Access permissions?
error.no_intercom: No intercom found in UniFi Access.

abort.wrong_console: This is a different console. Add it as a new entry instead.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the directory is read from the console.
data_description.restore_schedules: Access deletes the private schedule of a receiver when it is removed. When enabled, the schedule is saved and restored when the receiver is added again.
data_description.user_receivers: One switch per room is created for each selected user. Default: users that already receive calls.
data_description.track_calls: Read the ring history and the notification WebSocket to show which room was called and how the call ended.
